### New Beginnings: Ezekiel
Author: David Jeremiah
Site: David Jeremiah
URL: https://www.davidjeremiah.org/mapp/devo_xml?date=2020-01-25&id=1767
Passage: Ezekiel 1:1
Points:
- Ezekiel trained from a priestly family expecting to begin temple service at age thirty.
- Taken into Babylonian exile around age twenty-five, he lost his expected vocation and future.
- At his thirtieth year, while sitting among exiles by the Kebar River, God opened the heavens.
- Amid deep heartbreak and shattered plans, God redirected his life toward a prophetic calling.
- When human expectations collapse, God's glory and sovereign purpose can initiate fresh beginnings.

### The Word of the Lord to the Exiles
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/word-lord-exiles
Passage: Ezekiel 1:1-3
Points:
- Ezekiel was called to prophetic ministry at age thirty while living as a captive in Babylon.
- While other exiles harbored unfounded hopes of an early return, Ezekiel was tasked with proclaiming hard truth.
- Ancient Near Eastern belief held that deities were limited to distinct geographic territories and nations.
- By manifesting His word and hand in Chaldean lands, the Lord demonstrated His boundless presence and authority.
- Unlike modern relativistic ideas that diminish God, the Bible reveals Him as universal ruler over all creation.
